project_type: Spring Boot multi-module Maven reactor (microservices). This task touches only the xamops-service module.
language: Java 21 (Spring Boot 4.x, Jakarta Persistence), PostgreSQL in deployed profiles, H2 for JPA slice tests.
build_system: Maven reactor rooted at the worktree. NO maven wrapper (no mvnw); use the `mvn` on PATH (/opt/homebrew/bin/mvn). Work inside the module dir: `cd xamops-service`. Use `-pl .` to target the module and `-o` for offline where deps are cached. Surefire excludes the `containers` group by default (<surefire.excludedGroups>containers</surefire.excludedGroups>), so Testcontainers-tagged tests do not run and no Docker is needed.
verification_instructions: Build the module, then run the new tests by name first (fast), then the module test suite. Example targeted run: `cd xamops-service && mvn -o -pl . test -Dtest='ClusterCostSnapshotRepositoryTest,ClusterCostSnapshotServiceTest'`. There is ONE pre-existing unrelated failure on main: AwsPermissionCatalogKubernetesTest.logsDegradesKubernetes_andKeepsItsOtherFeatures (fails identically in isolation, touches nothing cost-related). Do NOT fix it; just ensure the new cost/snapshot tests pass in isolation so they are not masked by it.
environment_constraints: UAT runs spring.jpa.hibernate.ddl-auto=update against the SHARED xamops_db_uat (also used by billops and media-ops), so Hibernate may create the new table before Flyway sees it. Therefore the Flyway migration MUST be CREATE TABLE/INDEX IF NOT EXISTS with column types that exactly match what Hibernate maps the entity fields to, so whichever of Flyway or Hibernate runs first the other has nothing to ALTER. No destructive DDL. local profile has spring.flyway.enabled=false (relies on ddl-auto); uat/preprod/prod run Flyway. Scheduling is enabled globally via SchedulingConfig (@EnableScheduling, pool size 5).
contribution_requirements: CONTRIBUTING.md only warns against committing machine-specific absolute Java paths into .vscode/settings.json (CI fails PRs that reintroduce them) — do not touch .vscode. No other special contribution rules. Commit locally on the branch; never push.
key_patterns: Automation cost path is the ONLY authoritative engine: VerticalAutomationReadService.read(account, target, config) returns VerticalEngineResponse whose .cost() is the CostSummaryDto with .clusterMonthlyCost(). The pure WorkloadCostAttributionService.summary(List<WorkloadCostDto>) currently builds CostSummaryDto with previousClusterMonthlyCost=null and has NO cluster context — keep it pure; do the prior read-back in VerticalAutomationReadService.evaluate(...) (which has target.clusterConfigId()) via a NEW CostSummaryDto.withPreviousClusterMonthlyCost(Double) wither applied right after .withRollups(...). K8s automation rows are scoped by kubernetes_cluster_config.id (surrogate key), NEVER by the ambiguous cloud_account_id (audit B4). Entity convention: see WorkloadVerticalAction — plain `cluster_config_id` BIGINT column (logical FK, NO @ManyToOne), @Id @GeneratedValue(IDENTITY), java.time.Instant -> TIMESTAMPTZ, @PrePersist stamp. Scheduler convention: AutomaticApplyService enumerates clusterConfigRepository.findAll(), resolves CloudAccount with both-lookup B4 logic (resolveAccount), builds ClusterTarget, calls readService.read(...), runs in @Transactional(readOnly=true) so lazy CloudAccount.client resolves off the scheduled thread, injects a Clock seam, uses @Scheduled(fixedDelayString=...) with the master flag checked INSIDE the method (returns early when off). Properties convention: standalone @Component with @Value(":default") on every field (AutoApplyProperties / K8sCostProperties); master switch defaults false and is declared true ONLY in application-uat.properties. K8sCostProperties deliberately has NO KEYS parity test and declares its enabled key only in uat — follow that (no 5-profile parity requirement for the new snapshot properties). JPA slice tests use @DataJpaTest + @ContextConfiguration(classes = JpaSliceTestConfig.class) + @TestPropertySource(spring.flyway.enabled=false) on H2 (see WorkloadVerticalActionRepositoryTest). Cost unit tests are pure arithmetic over fixtures (WorkloadCostAttributionServiceTest).
